synthesis:draft.headline: Five‑minute RRP in SA1 reached $845.00 at interval ending 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST (2026-07-29T07:55:00Z).
summary: Five‑minute RRP peaked at $845.00 at interval ending 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST (2026-07-29T07:55:00Z).
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at that 5‑minute interval (interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z) was 1964.83 MW.
Operational demand (AEMO half‑hour) for the half‑hour containing the price extreme (half‑hour ending 2026-07-29T08:00:00Z = 2026-07-29 17:30 ACST) was 1872.0 MW.
The project analysis threshold is $300.0 ($/MWh); there were 26 five‑minute intervals at or above that threshold in the window.

The STPASA LOR2 notice gives 2026-07-29 10:00 ACST (2026-07-29T00:30:00Z), before the first 5-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z = 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

The STPASA LOR2 cancellation notice gives 2026-07-27 11:30 ACST (2026-07-27T02:00:00Z), before the first 5-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z = 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

The STPASA LOR2 notice (alternate timing) gives 2026-07-29 15:30 ACST (2026-07-29T06:00:00Z), before the first 5-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z = 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

The PDPASA LOR1 notice gives 2026-07-29 06:30 ACST (2026-07-28T21:00:00Z), before the first 5-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z = 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

The PDPASA LOR1 notice also lists a period from 2026-07-29 17:00 NEM time (2026-07-29T07:00:00Z / 2026-07-29 16:30 ACST) to 2026-07-29 22:30 NEM time (2026-07-29T12:30:00Z / 2026-07-29 22:00 ACST); that 22:30 NEM time is after the price extreme (interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z = 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

The PDPASA LOR1 cancellation notice gives 2026-07-28 13:15 ACST (2026-07-28T03:45:00Z), before the first 5-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z = 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

numeric_claims.text: Number of five‑minute intervals at or above the analysis threshold in the window

possible_explanations.statement: Offers or rebids after AEMO forecast LOR notices (for example, the PDPASA LOR1 notice [c3] and the STPASA LOR2 notice [c1]) may have left higher‑priced capacity setting the marginal price for the 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z dispatch interval.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain and inspect participant offer and rebid histories and timestamps for the SA1 region covering 2026-07-29T06:30:00Z through 2026-07-29T08:00:00Z and check whether upward rebids or withdrawal of low‑priced offers occurred prior to 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z (the interval with evidence_id ev0445).

possible_explanations.statement: A tightened real‑time reserve margin (the short reserve quantities noted in AEMO notices such as the PDPASA LOR1 notice [c3] and STPASA LOR2 notice [c1]) might have left the system with only higher‑priced offers available at dispatch.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare dispatch stacking and the marginal unit(s) for 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z (identify which offer set the price) and compare available capacity reported in MT/PDP/ST PASA snapshots around the notice times (e.g. times quoted in [c3] and [c1]) to the dispatched supply at 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z.

possible_explanations.statement: A sudden change in unit availability or an interconnector capability change could have reduced low‑priced supply just before 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z and so might coincide with the price spike.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine unit outage/availability records, SCADA time‑series for candidate units, interconnector capability and constraint notices timestamped around 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z to identify any trips, derates or constraint changes that would reduce low‑priced capacity immediately before 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z.
